darkhttpd 1.17, official upstream source:
https://github.com/emikulic/darkhttpd/tree/3075d35e1d2deb65ed8b079137c4ae1213de4b48

The C source and ISC license are retained verbatim. No application-specific modifications.
Compiled statically with musl in an Alpine build stage. The runtime contains only the binary,
license, MIME definitions, and public site files. No shell, package manager, PHP, Node, or database.
